description: Cancel a scheduled job by its schedule_id. Useful for cleaning up delayed reminders/timeouts or stopping periodic check-ins once the underlying work has completed. If you scheduled multiple related check-ins, consider using clear_scheduled_actions_by_tag instead of cancelling individual schedule_ids.
embedding_description: Cancel a scheduled action by schedule_id. Stop a reminder, timeout, or progress check-in. Cleanup scheduled follow-ups once work completes. Used with execute_in_seconds/create_cron_schedule. Prefer tag-based cleanup when multiple schedules were created.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation of schedule cancellation with the cancelled schedule_id
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: The schedule has been cancelled. Consider whether any pending user-facing check-in/reminder should be updated (or whether silent cleanup is sufficient).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Cancelling a scheduled job by its schedule_id
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError with 'schedule_id': no schedule exists with the given ID. AlreadyExecutedError: the scheduled action has already run and cannot be cancelled. SchedulerError: scheduling service unavailable.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For not found errors: verify the schedule_id is correct using list operations. For already executed: the action has completed; no cancellation needed. For scheduler errors: verify the scheduling service is running.
